Certainly! Here’s a draft of a concise professional follow-up email:

---

Subject: Request for Overdue Pricing Explanation

Dear [Vendor's Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

We are currently in the process of finalizing our contract with your company and have noticed that we have not received the requested pricing explanation as per our previous communication. Given the importance of this information, I would greatly appreciate a prompt response to provide us with the details needed for our next steps.

Could you please provide an update on when we can expect to receive the pricing documentation? Any assistance in resolving this matter will be highly appreciated.

Thank you very much for your attention to this matter. We look forward to your swift response.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Company Name]  
[Contact Information]

---

Feel free to adjust any details as necessary!
